archetypes.name: bash-state
archetypes.rationale: The diff moves stall-state mutation into shell helpers with atomic rewrite and KV-emission contracts that need focused validation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell implementation details introduced for stall state persistence, especially key rewriting, temp-file replacement, reread assertions, and non-symlink validation. Check whether every malformed-state and operational-failure path emits the promised machine key before exiting under set -euo pipefail. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: teardown-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The Step 18b extraction changes prompt-side versus script-side responsibilities around final report emission and sentinels.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new Step 18b wrapper and its integration with SKILL.md, focusing on whether body emission and .step17-emitted remain prompt-side only. Verify the EMIT_BODY, WFR_RC, snapshot comparison, empty-body, token-report-failure, and write-final-report-failure gates preserve the intended final-report behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: This repository explicitly supports bash 3.2 and the diff adds nontrivial shell scripts and harness code.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the added and modified shell scripts for bash 3.2 compatibility, quoting, local variable behavior, trap or set -e interactions, and reliance on GNU-only utilities. Pay special attention to helper scripts copied into stub plugin roots and any awk, mktemp, mv, cmp, or env usage that may differ across supported environments. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-wiring
archetypes.rationale: The change adds a new harness and repins aggregate Makefile shards, which can fail through wiring drift rather than functional code bugs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Makefile registration, phony targets, shard inclusion, and new offline harness setup for the Step 18b wrapper. Check whether the harness stubs faithfully exercise the production helper paths and whether structural pin updates still protect the behavior described in the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
